simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֵבֶךְ (H5033) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: נֵבֶךְ (nêbek) means a fountain First listed occurrence: Job 38 16.

definitions.full: H5033. nebek [ נֵ֫בֶךְ ] noun [masculine] spring (si vera lectio) (v unknown); — only plural construct נִבְכֵייָֿם Job 38:16 the springs, sources of the ocean (|| תְּהוֺם חֵ֫קֶר ); — Ol Siegf נִבְלֵי ; Bu suggests נבעי = מֵבֻּעֵי as possibly; but Gr Perles read נִבְכֵי 28:11 , also, for Masora מִבְּכִי , compare נָהָר 2 I. נבל (√ of following; meaning dubious).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to burst forth ;
